meta.version: hidden-rubric-v2 (2026-10-25 cleanup: measurements moved into checks.py)
meta.scoring: 每条判定二元；部分满足即判否。critical=true 的判定由 checks.py 机测失败时，同 group 其余判定记 0（组级门槛；Blender 导出失败/超时不触发）。reward = Σ(权重×通过)/Σ(权重)，权重合计 74（基础 17、中间 31、门槛 26）；M15（ASR，权重0）只作信息。M01 的 ASR 部分拆为 M15 后，M01 权重 3→1，其余 2 按比例分给 mid 层（mid 各条 ×31/29）。除 M14（qa.md 与证据对照）、G10 的画面部分与 G11（联系表叙事）由评委判定外，其余全部由 checks.py 机测。所有按时间评分的非剪辑事件均按 events.csv 声明帧测量；片中第 f 帧 = 场景第 frame_start+f 帧。
meta.score_formula: score = 100 * sum(weight_i * pass_i) / sum(weight_i), weights sum to 74; pass_i in {0,1} after group gates
hidden_conventions: FIDE 6.2.3/7.5-type practice: press the clock with the same hand that moved the piece
board placed with a light square at each player's right (h1 light)
analog clock: only the side to move runs; the flag is lifted by the minute hand and drops
cross-cut causality: arbiter mirrors only after the real move
judge_items: G10 (visual part, after the measured parts pass)

criteria.criterion_zh: 基础版成片编码契约：H.264、yuv420p、1280×720 方形像素、恒定 30 fps、解码恰好 900 帧；AAC 立体声 48 kHz 且音频覆盖全部画面。
criteria.criterion_en: Base film contract: H.264 yuv420p 1280x720 square pixels, CFR 30 fps, exactly 900 decoded frames; AAC stereo 48 kHz covering the picture.
criteria.verify: ffprobe -count_frames；检查 codec_name/pix_fmt/sample_aspect_ratio/r_frame_rate=avg_frame_rate/nb_read_frames；音频时长 ≥ 29.97 s。

criteria.criterion_zh: 修订版成片同一编码契约且解码恰好 885 帧。
criteria.criterion_en: Revision film: same contract, exactly 885 decoded frames.
criteria.verify: ffprobe 同 B01，帧数 885。

criteria.criterion_zh: 两版母带：综合响度 −23 ±2 LUFS，真峰值 ≤ −1 dBTP，解码后无连续 ≥3 个满幅样本。
criteria.criterion_en: Both masters: integrated −23 ±2 LUFS, true peak ≤ −1 dBTP, no clipped runs.
criteria.verify: ffmpeg -af ebur128=peak=true；numpy 统计 |x|≥0.999 的连续样本。

criteria.criterion_zh: 三条分轨 speech/table/room 为 48 kHz PCM、各 30.0 s（±1 帧）；与解码混音对齐（≤5 ms 编码延迟）后在 ≤4 kHz 低通带内最小二乘残差 ≤ −25 dB（相对同带混音 RMS）；timeline.json 声明的母带增益（自动定位；键名含 db 按 dB，否则线性或 dB 取相符者）与拟合增益相差 ≤1 dB。增益未声明/无法定位判否。
criteria.criterion_en: Stems speech/table/room are 48 kHz PCM, 30.0 s (±1 frame); after ≤5 ms alignment the stems match the decoded mix in the ≤4 kHz low-passed band with residual ≤ −25 dB re mix RMS in that band; master gains declared in timeline.json (located automatically; dB if the key says db, else linear or dB) are within 1 dB of the fitted gains. Undeclared/unlocatable gains fail.
criteria.verify: soundfile 读入；互相关求 AAC 延迟；4 kHz 低通后算残差能量比（实测 AAC 192k 宽带编码残差约 −16 dB，−35 dB 对正确作品不可达；4 kHz 以下约 −32 dB；1 dB 增益误差≈−19 dB 仍判否）。

criteria.criterion_zh: events.csv 表头逐字为 event_id,frame,description；15 个必需 id 全部存在且唯一，frame 为 0–899 的整数。
criteria.criterion_en: events.csv header exact; all 15 required ids present once; integer frames in 0–899.
criteria.verify: csv 解析。

criteria.criterion_zh: project/scene.blend 可在 Blender 4.3 后台打开；题面列出的全部对象名存在且类型正确（人物、骨架、BOARD/DEMO_BOARD、10 枚棋子、CLOCK 及 6 个部件、CAM_S1–S6）；场景有自定义属性 revision_trim_frames。（评分方导出超时只使本条失败，不触发 PROJ 组门槛。）
criteria.criterion_en: project/scene.blend opens headless in Blender 4.3; every listed object name exists with the right type (characters/armatures, BOARD/DEMO_BOARD, 10 pieces, CLOCK and its 6 parts, CAM_S1–S6); scene custom property revision_trim_frames exists. (A grader-side inspection timeout fails this item without the PROJ group gate.)
criteria.verify: blender -b -y scene.blend --python（_cdc_blend.rich_dump）。

criteria.criterion_zh: 严格六镜头 S1→S6：剪辑点位于第 120/270/390/570/720 帧（±1），五处均为硬切（剪辑两侧无混合帧）；无其他剪切；剪辑点附近无叠化；无定格（解码后连续 ≥6 帧除编码舍入外完全相同，即全分辨率亮度无像素变化超过 2 级；静态镜头须有可见运动或渲染噪声）。画面叠加由 G11 判。
criteria.criterion_en: Exactly six shots; cuts at frames 120/270/390/570/720 (±1), all hard cuts with no blend frames; no extra cuts; no dissolve near the edit points; no freeze (≥6 consecutive decoded frames identical up to codec rounding, i.e. no full-resolution luma pixel changes by more than 2 levels; a static shot needs visible motion or render noise). Overlays are judged in G11.
criteria.verify: 320×180 灰度帧差+直方图检测硬切（暗场景在预期切点接受明显局部峰值）；预期切点 ±6 帧查叠化；全分辨率逐帧流式比较查定格（容差2级）。

criteria.criterion_zh: credits.md 与 qa.md 存在；credits.md 说明台词制作方式（espeak-ng/sox/TTS/合成/录制人声）；交付的所有文本文件中无凭据、无 http(s) 媒体引用。
criteria.criterion_en: credits.md and qa.md exist; credits.md states how the spoken lines were produced (espeak-ng/sox/TTS/synthesised/recorded voice); no credentials or http(s) media references in any text file of the delivery.
criteria.verify: checks.py：文件存在 + 关键词正则 + 凭据/URL 媒体正则。

criteria.criterion_zh: 台词时序与语速：line_black、line_arbiter 实测语音段（能量 VAD −45 dBFS、10 ms、<300 ms 间隙合并）起止与 events.csv 声明值相差 ≤ 6 帧，语速 1.5–5 词/秒（词数按 transcript.en.txt 书写计：4、3）。可懂度（ASR）见信息项 M15。
criteria.criterion_en: Speech timing and rate: for line_black and line_arbiter the measured speech segment (energy VAD −45 dBFS, 10 ms, gaps <300 ms merged) starts and ends within 6 frames of the declared line_*_start/end, and the speech rate is 1.5–5 words/s (words as written in transcript.en.txt: 4 and 3). Intelligibility (ASR) is informational item M15.
criteria.verify: speech.wav 能量 VAD。

criteria.criterion_zh: T56 J-cut：裁判台词在语音分轨上（黑方台词结束后首个高于 −50 dBFS 的 10 ms 窗）于 23.40 ±0.05 s 起音，且声明 line_arbiter_start=702±2；黑方台词结束后到 23.35 s 之间语音分轨低于 −50 dBFS。
criteria.criterion_en: T56 J-cut: arbiter line onset (first 10 ms window above −50 dBFS after the end of Black's line) in the speech stem at 23.40 ±0.05 s and declared line_arbiter_start = 702 ±2; speech stem below −50 dBFS between the end of Black's line and 23.35 s.
criteria.verify: 语音分轨 10 ms RMS 包络；起音搜索从黑方句实测结束+0.1 s（不早于 20 s）开始。

criteria.criterion_zh: T45 L-cut：黑方台词实测起音位于 S4 内（13.0–19.0 s），且结束晚于 19.15 s、早于 23.35 s。
criteria.criterion_en: T45 L-cut: Black line starts inside S4 and ends after 19.15 s (before 23.35 s).
criteria.verify: 同 M02 包络。

criteria.criterion_zh: 开局局面正确：第 0 帧在 BOARD 局部坐标下，以五枚棋子（采样质心）对其 FEN 格的最小二乘拟合格边长，须与 0.055 m 相差 ≤15%；每枚棋子离其 FEN 格心 ≤0.3 格且直立（≤15°）；64 格内无其他棋子对象（W_/B_+棋种）；BOARD 为网格时其外形与 8 格加每边至多 4 cm 边框相符。（片中第 f 帧 = 场景第 frame_start+f 帧）
criteria.criterion_en: Frame-0 position matches the FEN in BOARD local coordinates: the square size is fitted to the five piece centres (sample centroids) at their FEN squares and must be within 15% of 0.055 m; every piece is ≤0.3 square from its FEN square centre and upright (≤15°); no other piece object (W_/B_ + piece type) stands on the 64 squares; if BOARD is a mesh its outline is consistent with 8 squares plus a border of at most 4 cm per side. (film frame f = scene frame frame_start+f)
criteria.verify: rich_dump：matrix_world + 网格采样；格索引 = floor(x/s+4)。

criteria.criterion_zh: 终局局面正确：b_press 之后至 king_tip 之前，B_ROOK 在 f5、B_KING f7、W_KING g2、W_PAWN f2（格边长取 M04 拟合值，偏离 ≤0.3 格）；W_KNIGHT 不在 64 格任何格内；上述四子位移 ≤5 mm。（片中第 f 帧 = 场景第 frame_start+f 帧）
criteria.criterion_en: After b_press until king_tip: B_ROOK on f5, B_KING f7, W_KING g2, W_PAWN f2 (fitted square size from M04, ≤0.3 square), W_KNIGHT on none of the 64 squares, and none of those four pieces moves >5 mm. (film frame f = scene frame frame_start+f)
criteria.verify: 同 M04 逐帧。

criteria.criterion_zh: 演示棋盘镜像：demo_move_start 前 DEMO_* 摆出开局局面，demo_move_end 后 DEMO_W_KNIGHT 位于 f5、其余不变（DEMO_BOARD 局部坐标，格边长按开局局面拟合，5–20 cm）；DEMO_BOARD 竖直挂墙（法线水平 ±15°），局部 +Y 与世界 +Z 夹角 ≤15°（第 1 横排在下方）。（片中第 f 帧 = 场景第 frame_start+f 帧）
criteria.criterion_en: Demo board mirrors the game: before demo_move_start the DEMO_* pieces show the start position and after demo_move_end DEMO_W_KNIGHT is on f5 with the others unchanged (DEMO_BOARD local coordinates, square size fitted to the start position, 5–20 cm); DEMO_BOARD hangs vertically (normal within 15° of horizontal) with local +Y within 15° of world up (rank 1 at the bottom). (film frame f = scene frame frame_start+f)
criteria.verify: inspect 脚本：DEMO_BOARD 局部坐标 + 局部 +Y 与世界 +Z 夹角 ≤ 15°（与判定文本的 ±15° 一致）。

criteria.criterion_zh: 棋钟按键（按键网格质心在 CLOCK 局部坐标的高度，阈值为两状态中点）：CLOCK_BUTTON_W 在 w_press ±2 帧内由高变低（同时 CLOCK_BUTTON_B 升起），CLOCK_BUTTON_B 在 b_press ±2 帧内由高变低；其余时间按键状态不变。（片中第 f 帧 = 场景第 frame_start+f 帧）
criteria.criterion_en: Rocker buttons (heights of the button mesh centroids in CLOCK local coordinates, threshold half-way between the two states): CLOCK_BUTTON_W goes down at w_press ±2 (B up) and CLOCK_BUTTON_B goes down at b_press ±2 (W up); no other state changes. (film frame f = scene frame frame_start+f)
criteria.verify: 按键在 CLOCK 局部坐标的高度差，阈值为两状态差的一半。

criteria.criterion_zh: 动作声音同步（table 与 room 分轨相加）：w_place、w_press、b_press 各 ±2 帧内有瞬态（5 ms 窗，高于前 200 ms 中位 ≥12 dB）；b_capture_contact 到 knight_rest 之间有 ≥2 个起音。
criteria.criterion_en: Foley sync (table + room stems summed): a transient (≥12 dB above the median of the prior 200 ms, 5 ms windows) within ±2 frames of w_place, w_press and b_press; ≥2 onsets between b_capture_contact and knight_rest.
criteria.verify: numpy 5 ms 包络起音检测。

criteria.criterion_zh: 钟的走动声（table 与 room 分轨相加）：S5（19–24 s）内有 ≥4 个连续起音，相邻间隔 0.1–1.2 s 且变异系数 ≤0.2。
criteria.criterion_en: Clock running audible in S5 (table + room stems summed): ≥4 consecutive onsets in 19–24 s with intervals 0.1–1.2 s and coefficient of variation ≤0.2.
criteria.verify: 同 M08 起音序列。

criteria.criterion_zh: 景别／角度由工程数据核验（宽松）：S1 全程俯角（俯仰 ≤ −8°），三人头部点（各骨架 head 骨）在镜头首/中/末帧均投影在画内，位移 <1 cm；S2（过黑方肩）与 S4（过白方肩）：前景棋手头部投影落在画框外侧 40%（u<0.4 或 u>0.6，或出画）且比另一人头部更近相机，全程浅景深开启 f≤5.6；S3 横移（垂直光轴方向的位移）≥0.1 m；S5 CLOCK 及部件投影宽度 ≥ 画宽 35%、景深开启；S6 两名棋手头部首末帧均在画内、相机光轴与两头连线夹角 60–120°、到两头中点距离缩短 ≥0.05 m、焦距不变。（片中第 f 帧 = 场景第 frame_start+f 帧）
criteria.criterion_en: Camera grammar from project data (tolerant): S1 pitch ≤ −8° (looking down) throughout, all three head points (head bone of each rig) inside the frame at the start, middle and end, displacement <1 cm; S2 (over Black's shoulder) and S4 (over White's shoulder): the foreground player's head projects into the outer 40% of the frame (u<0.4 or u>0.6, or outside) and is nearer the camera than the other head, DOF on with f≤5.6 throughout; S3 lateral truck (displacement perpendicular to the view axis) ≥0.1 m; S5 the CLOCK and its parts span ≥35% of the frame width, DOF on; S6 both players' heads inside the frame at start and end, camera axis at 60–120° to the line between their heads, distance to the midpoint of the heads decreases ≥0.05 m, constant focal length. (film frame f = scene frame frame_start+f)
criteria.verify: rich_dump 逐帧导出相机 matrix_world/lens/传感器/dof 与骨骼；投影与 bpy_extras.world_to_camera_view 一致。

criteria.criterion_zh: 修订传播：修订版 885 帧；第 0–374 帧与基础版同帧 PSNR ≥ 30 dB（每 10 帧抽样，320×180 亮度）；第 f≥375 帧与基础版 f+15 帧 PSNR ≥ 30 dB；12.5 s 前混音与基础版一致（≤4 kHz 带内残差 ≤ −25 dB，同 B04）、之后整体前移 0.500 ±0.01 s；修订版 timeline.json 含前移后的镜头起点 375/555/705 与终点 884/885（帧或秒），且不同时保留旧起点 390/570/720。
criteria.criterion_en: Revision: 885 frames; frames 0–374 equal base (PSNR ≥30 dB, every 10th frame, 320×180 luma); frames ≥375 equal base f+15; mix before 12.5 s unchanged (≤4 kHz residual ≤ −25 dB, as B04) and shifted −0.500 ±0.01 s after it; revision/timeline.json contains the shifted shot starts 375/555/705 and the end 884/885 (frames or seconds) and not all of the old starts 390/570/720.
criteria.verify: ffmpeg 解码 PSNR；音频互相关；timeline 数值扫描。

criteria.criterion_zh: 工程即真实来源：评分方从 scene.blend（revision_trim_frames=0）重渲第 60/200/330/480/650/820 帧（480×270、8 spp；无绑定相机的标记时用 CAM_S1–S6；求解者渲染器无输出时改用 Cycles），与成片 480×270 SSIM 均 ≥ 0.75。渲染失败/超时判否。（片中第 f 帧 = 场景第 frame_start+f 帧）
criteria.criterion_en: Project is the source of truth: the grader re-renders frames 60/200/330/480/650/820 from scene.blend (revision_trim_frames=0; 480×270, 8 spp; CAM_S1–S6 if no camera-bound markers; Cycles fallback if the solver engine writes no image); each SSIM ≥0.75 against the film at 480×270. A failed/timed-out render fails this item. (film frame f = scene frame frame_start+f)
criteria.verify: blender -b -y 低采样重渲 + SSIM。

criteria.criterion_zh: 事件合理性（按声明帧）：w_lift<w_place<w_press，且 w_lift…w_glance 均在 S2；demo_move_start>w_press，且 demo_move_start、demo_move_end 均在 S3；b_capture_contact、knight_rest、b_press 在 S4 且 contact<rest；flag_fall 在 S5；line_arbiter_start ≥ flag_fall+3；king_tip 在 S6。
criteria.criterion_en: Declared events are ordered causally and fall in their shots.
criteria.verify: events.csv 规则检查。

criteria.criterion_zh: 如实质检：qa.md 中所有可核对的数值声明（帧号、电平、时长、帧数）与交付文件及探测/响度/events/timeline 证据一致；任一被证据否定的声明判否；如实写明“未发现问题”可以通过。
criteria.criterion_en: Truthful QA: every checkable numeric claim in qa.md (frame numbers, levels, durations, frame counts) is consistent with the delivered files and the probe/loudness/events/timeline evidence; any claim contradicted by that evidence fails; a truthful "no problems found" statement is acceptable.
criteria.verify: 评委将 qa.md 声明与 ffprobe/响度/events.csv/timeline.json 证据对照。

criteria.criterion_zh: （信息项，权重0——评分镜像中无 ASR 模型。）台词准确可懂：离线 whisper small.en（temperature 0）文本归一化（小写、去标点、展开缩写）后每句 ≤1 词错（两句合计 7 词，合并 WER ≤ 0.29）。
criteria.criterion_en: (Informational, weight 0 — no ASR model in the verifier image.) Speech intelligible: offline whisper small.en after normalisation ≤1 word error per line (pooled WER ≤0.29 over 7 words).
criteria.verify: 不评分；不交评委（weight 0 → na）。

criteria.criterion_zh: 双钟走停逻辑：CLOCK_HAND_W 在 [0, w_press) 与 [b_press, flag_fall] 内单调同向转动（总转角 ≥0.2°）、在 [w_press, b_press) 内静止（漂移 <0.2°）；CLOCK_HAND_B 只在 [w_press, b_press) 内转动、其余时间静止（各 2–3 帧容差；flag_fall 之后白方指针继续走或停住均可）。转角相对 CLOCK 计。（片中第 f 帧 = 场景第 frame_start+f 帧）
criteria.criterion_en: Clock logic: CLOCK_HAND_W turns monotonically (same rotation axis, ≥0.2° total) in [0, w_press) and [b_press, flag_fall], is static (<0.2° drift) in [w_press, b_press); CLOCK_HAND_B turns only in [w_press, b_press) and is static otherwise (±2–3 frame margins; after flag_fall White's hand may run or stop). Rotations measured relative to CLOCK. (film frame f = scene frame frame_start+f)
criteria.verify: inspect 脚本：指针在 CLOCK 局部坐标的绕表盘法线角度逐帧序列。

criteria.criterion_zh: 落旗因果：flag_fall 前 60 帧内 FLAG_W（相对 CLOCK）随 CLOCK_HAND_W 转动而上抬 ≥5°；flag_fall ±3 帧内下落 ≥45° 并保持到片尾；FLAG_B 全片转角 <45°；flag_fall 位于 S5 且此时 FLAG_W 投影在 CAM_S5 画框内。（片中第 f 帧 = 场景第 frame_start+f 帧）
criteria.criterion_en: Flag causality: during the 60 frames before flag_fall FLAG_W rotates up by ≥5° (relative to CLOCK) while CLOCK_HAND_W turns; within flag_fall ±3 frames FLAG_W drops ≥45° and is still down at the end; FLAG_B never rotates ≥45°; flag_fall lies in S5 and FLAG_W projects inside the CAM_S5 frame at flag_fall. (film frame f = scene frame frame_start+f)
criteria.verify: BVH 最近距离 + 旗绕枢轴角度；投影检查。

criteria.criterion_zh: 同手拍钟：两名棋手各自在落子帧（白方 w_place；黑方 b_capture_contact 后 B_ROOK 首次停稳帧）距所走棋子最近的手，与 *_press 时距本方按键 ≤ 5 cm 的手为同一只，且该手距本方按键比距对方按键近（左右按骨名判定，否则按骨架局部 x 符号）。（片中第 f 帧 = 场景第 frame_start+f 帧）
criteria.criterion_en: Same-hand rule: for each player the hand nearest to the moved piece at the place frame (White: w_place; Black: first frame after b_capture_contact at which B_ROOK has stopped) is the hand that is ≤5 cm from that player's own clock button at *_press, and that hand is nearer to the own button than to the opponent's (side from bone names, else armature-local x sign). (film frame f = scene frame frame_start+f)
criteria.verify: rich_dump 手部骨段到棋子/按键网格采样的最近距离。

criteria.criterion_zh: 轴线与视线：CAM_S1/S2/S4/S6 全程（每 5 帧抽样）位于两名棋手头部点连线所在竖直平面的同一侧；CAM_S2 中白→黑的屏幕方向与 CAM_S4 中黑→白相反；w_glance 时白方头部前向（第 0 帧指向黑方的 head 骨局部 ±X/±Z 轴）与指向黑方头部的方向夹角 ≤ 25°。（片中第 f 帧 = 场景第 frame_start+f 帧）
criteria.criterion_en: Axis and eyeline: CAM_S1/S2/S4/S6 stay on one side of the vertical plane through both players' head points (sampled every 5 frames); the screen direction from White to Black in CAM_S2 is opposite to the direction from Black to White in CAM_S4; at w_glance White's head forward axis (the head bone's local ±X/±Z axis that points toward Black at frame 0) is within 25° of the direction to Black's head. (film frame f = scene frame frame_start+f)
criteria.verify: rich_dump：骨骼位置与 head 骨世界旋转；相机投影。

criteria.criterion_zh: 棋盘摆放惯例：评分方在每块棋盘法线方向加正交相机渲染顶视图（96×96、Cycles 8 spp、第 0 帧），BOARD 与 DEMO_BOARD 上与 h1 同色的格（列号+行号为奇数）亮度中位数 ≥ 与 a1 同色格的 1.15 倍（有子格不计）；白方头部位于 BOARD 局部 −Y 一侧。
criteria.criterion_en: Board convention: in a grader top-view render (orthographic camera on each board's normal, 96×96, Cycles 8 spp, frame 0) the median luminance of the h1-coloured squares ((file+rank) odd) is ≥1.15× that of the a1-coloured squares on both BOARD and DEMO_BOARD (occupied squares excluded); White's head is on BOARD's local −Y side.
criteria.verify: blender -b -y 加正交相机渲染 + 格心采样。

criteria.criterion_zh: 被吃的马：W_KNIGHT 为刚体世界中启用的主动刚体且缓存已烘焙（存于 .blend 或 project/ 下 blendcache_* 目录）；knight_rest+3 帧时与棋盘法线夹角 >60°，位于 64 格以外、棋盘附近桌面上（棋盘局部 z −0.10…+0.08 m，|x|,|y| ≤0.8 m）；knight_rest ±3 帧内某帧起连续 10 帧速度 <1 mm/帧；b_capture_contact 至 knight_rest+13 无单帧跳变 >3 cm；静止的马投影在 CAM_S4 画框内。（片中第 f 帧 = 场景第 frame_start+f 帧）
criteria.criterion_en: Captured knight: W_KNIGHT is an enabled ACTIVE rigid body in the rigid-body world with a baked cache (in the .blend or a blendcache_* directory under project/); at knight_rest+3 it is tilted >60° from the board normal and lies off the 64 squares on the table near the board (board-local z −0.10…+0.08 m, |x|,|y| ≤0.8 m); it is at rest (<1 mm/frame for 10 frames starting within knight_rest ±3); no single-frame jump >3 cm from b_capture_contact to knight_rest+13; the resting knight projects inside the CAM_S4 frame. (film frame f = scene frame frame_start+f)
criteria.verify: rich_dump：rigid_body/point_cache 设置 + 逐帧变换 + 投影。

criteria.criterion_zh: 放倒的王：king_tip ±3 帧内白方手/手指骨距 W_KING ≤ 3 cm；W_KING 为启用的主动刚体且缓存已烘焙，king_tip 后 60 帧内倾角 > 60°，片尾静止于棋盘上（棋盘局部 |x|,|y| ≤4 格、z −0.02…+0.06 m、<1 mm/帧），且投影在 CAM_S6 画框内。（片中第 f 帧 = 场景第 frame_start+f 帧）
criteria.criterion_en: Tipped king: around king_tip (±3 frames) a White hand/finger bone is ≤3 cm from W_KING; W_KING is an enabled ACTIVE rigid body with a baked cache, tilts >60° within 60 frames after king_tip, is at rest on the board at the end (board-local |x|,|y| ≤4 squares, z −0.02…+0.06 m, <1 mm/frame) and projects inside the CAM_S6 frame. (film frame f = scene frame frame_start+f)
criteria.verify: 同 G06。

criteria.criterion_zh: 可动人物：PLAYER_W、PLAYER_B、ARBITER 各由对应骨架驱动（修改器或骨架父级）且为立体网格（世界包围盒三轴 ≥0.1 m）；每个骨架两只手各有 ≥4 条 ≥3 骨的手指链，其动作手 ≥4 条手指链各有 ≥3 根带关键帧的骨，且至少 2 根手指关键帧曲线不同（独立动画）。
criteria.criterion_en: Characters: each of PLAYER_W, PLAYER_B, ARBITER is deformed by its armature (modifier or armature parent) and is volumetric (world bbox ≥0.1 m on every axis); each rig has ≥4 finger chains of ≥3 bones on both hands, and on its acting hand ≥4 finger chains with ≥3 keyed bones each, at least 2 of them with different keyframe curves (individually animated).
criteria.verify: rich_dump：armature 修改器/父级、骨表、fcurve（含 NLA）。

criteria.criterion_zh: 口型同步：S4（第 390–569 帧）中黑方与 S6（第 720–899 帧）中裁判，各自至少一条口部通道（其骨架 jaw/chin/mouth/lip 姿态骨旋转或位移，或其网格上 jaw/mouth/viseme 形态键）与语音分轨 30 fps RMS 包络在 ±2 帧（≤80 ms）滞后内 r ≥ 0.4。（片中第 f 帧 = 场景第 frame_start+f 帧）
criteria.criterion_en: Lip sync: for Black in S4 (frames 390–569) and the arbiter in S6 (720–899) at least one mouth channel (jaw/chin/mouth/lip pose-bone rotation or translation of that character's rig, or a jaw/mouth/viseme shape key on its meshes) correlates with the 30 fps RMS envelope of the speech stem with r ≥0.4 at a lag within ±2 frames (≤80 ms). (film frame f = scene frame frame_start+f)
criteria.verify: rich_dump 口部通道逐帧值 vs speech.wav 包络。

criteria.criterion_zh: 写实渲染：（机测）主体对象 BOARD、W_KNIGHT、B_ROOK、W_KING、PLAYER_W、PLAYER_B、ARBITER 使用基于节点的 BSDF 材质，其中 ≥3 个有纹理或接节点的 BSDF 输入（表面变化）；至少一个柔光（面光、尺寸/半径 >2 cm、日光角 >0.3°）或环境/天空世界光；Cycles 渲染开启降噪；6 个镜头中至少 3 个平涂块指数 ≤ 0.35（方差 <1.0 且与上下左右 4 块均值差均 <0.5 的 8×8 亮度块，排除均值 <24 或 >235，每 15 帧抽样、每镜头取中位数）；（画面，评委）联系表呈现写实材质与光照，无平面着色/卡通/白模外观，棋子为 Staunton 造型（马头、城堡形车、十字王冠）。组级门槛（REAL 组无其他条目）。
criteria.criterion_en: Photoreal render: (measured) hero objects BOARD, W_KNIGHT, B_ROOK, W_KING, PLAYER_W, PLAYER_B, ARBITER use node-based BSDF materials, ≥3 of them with a texture or linked BSDF input (surface variation); at least one soft light (area, size/radius >2 cm, sun angle >0.3°) or an environment/sky world; Cycles renders denoised; flat-block index ≤0.35 in at least 3 of 6 shots (8×8 luma block with variance <1.0 whose mean differs <0.5 from all 4 neighbours, excluding mean <24 or >235; per-shot median, frames every 15); (visual, judge) the contact sheets show photoreal materials and lighting, no flat-shaded/cartoon/clay look, and Staunton-shaped pieces (horse-head knight, castle rook, cross-topped king). Group gate (group REAL has no other item).
criteria.verify: checks.py 先测材质/灯光/降噪/平涂块指数，任一不合格直接判否；全部合格时交评委看联系表。

criteria.criterion_zh: 叙事可读（画面）：仅凭联系表即可看出白方走马拍钟→裁判在墙上演示板同步→黑方用车吃马→钟上白方落旗→裁判到桌边、白方推倒己王；能认出执白者（灰色开衫、白子在其一侧）；画面无字幕、字卡或叠加图形。
criteria.criterion_en: Narrative readability (visual): from the contact sheets alone one can follow White moving the knight and pressing the clock → the arbiter mirroring the move on the wall demo board → Black capturing with the rook → White's flag down on the clock → the arbiter at the table and White's king tipped over; the White player is identifiable (grey cardigan, white pieces on his side); no captions, title cards or graphic overlays appear.
criteria.verify: 评委看两版成片联系表（视觉判断）。

criteria.criterion_zh: 修订依赖：声明 demo_move_end ≤ 368；以 revision_trim_frames=15 重新导出工程（第二次 Blender 导出，修订版第 0–884 帧）时 DEMO_W_KNIGHT 在缩短后的 S3 内（至第 374 帧）位于 f5 ≥6 帧，G01 的指针逻辑与 G02 的落旗逻辑在 S4 起事件 −15 帧后仍成立，且 flag_fall−15 位于修订版 S5（555–704）。（片中第 f 帧 = 场景第 frame_start+f 帧）
criteria.criterion_en: Revision dependency: declared demo_move_end ≤368; re-evaluating the project with revision_trim_frames=15 (second Blender dump, revision frames 0–884) DEMO_W_KNIGHT is on f5 for ≥6 frames inside the trimmed S3 (up to frame 374), the clock-hand logic of G01 and the flag logic of G02 hold with events from S4 on shifted by −15 frames, and flag_fall−15 lies in the revision S5 (555–704). (film frame f = scene frame frame_start+f)
criteria.verify: rich_dump(props={revision_trim_frames: 15})。
